title: StatNext: point-and-click statistics with reproducible R code
description: StatNext is a free desktop statistics application for Windows, macOS and Linux. Analyses are chosen from menus and computed by a local R installation; every result is returned together with the plain R code that produced it, so analyses can be reproduced outside the application. Plots are drawn with the ggnext R package and results include plain-language summaries from easystats.
